thread:
maria: FYI - canary deploy 'optimize-batching=v2' just went out to ~10% and we're seeing a spike in 502/504s from hosted inference. Customers reporting timeouts. Investigating now.
jonah: seeing it in SLO dashboard. 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 7% in last 2m. Most errors show gateway 502 with upstream timeout.
sam: digging into the canary config diff now. Might be a shedder/batching window change. Pulling the diff.
lee: logs show a lot of "rpc: context deadline exceeded" from model-proxy on host pool-a. Trace IDs: tx=7f3a21.. sample: `trace=7f3a21, inst=proxy-2, code=502`
maria: can we pause the canary traffic? If rollback is fastest, let's coordinate. @deploy-bot can you throttle traffic to canary? :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Received request to update rollout. Applying traffic cut to 0% for release/optimize-batching on cluster=hosted-us-west. (cmd: `redwoodctl rollout set --release optimize-batching --percent 0 --env hosted-us-west`)
jonah: nice, traffic cut started. Confirming 1m after rollback for error delta.
kate: quick note from support queue — several enterprise customers saw 504s on large prompt sequences, also a spike in token billing retries. Putting them in high-priority.
sam: found the config mismatch: canary enabled `continuous_batching=true` but also set `kv_cache_prefetch=on` with a shorter prefetch window. Combined it increased proxy time waiting for KV fill on cold shards. Here's the diff: ```
- continuous_batching=false
- kv_cache_prefetch=off
+ continuous_batching=true
+ kv_cache_prefetch=on
+ prefetch_window_ms=50
```
lee: that prefetch_window looks aggressive. On longer sequences it causes the proxy to wait for stale KV entries when the backend is busy -> timeouts.
maria: thanks. rolling back the config to previous values and re-enabling canary only after tests. @deploy-bot run rollback to previous config version.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: `redwoodctl config rollback --release optimize-batching --to-version v23`
jonah: telemetry shows 5xx dropping back toward baseline within 90s of rollback. Confirming logs show far fewer `context deadline exceeded`.
sam: pushing a repro script to #eng-sre with instructions to repro locally (will include curl + headers). Example quick repro: ```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-rlhf-3b","input":"<long prompt>...","max_tokens":4096}'
# expect 502 when canary config active, 200 after rollback
```
lee: also dumping sample proxy stack trace for SRE debug: ```
[proxy] 2026-03-17T22:14:02Z WARN rpc deadline exceeded: downstream=backend-21 shard=9 wait=120ms
[proxy] 2026-03-17T22:14:02Z ERROR upstream 502: downstream timeout
```
maria: I'll coordinate postmortem and add a test case that exercises batching+kv_prefetch combos. Suggest gating that combo behind a perf-run in staging.
kate: I'll follow up with impacted customers with ETA and mitigation notes — let me know when we have a written summary.
jonah: action items: 1) add automated regression test for batching+kv_prefetch 2) add rollout check that disallows prefetch_window_ms < 200ms in canary 3) update runbook with quick rollback commands.
maria: agreed. Thanks all — closing the immediate alert. Will create incident ticket and assign owners for the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
